subject: Game Theory
title: The Ethics of Design
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Ethics of Design.

hook.text: A kidney matching algorithm maximizes total lives saved. But it gives fewer matches to rare blood types. Is that fair?

buildup.text: Mechanism design optimizes objectives. But who chooses the objective? Efficiency, equity, and fairness often conflict.

discovery.text: Designers embed values in algorithms: prioritizing efficiency helps more people but can exclude minorities.

twist.text: School choice algorithms had to add fairness constraints after minority communities were systematically disadvantaged.

climax.text: The frontier of mechanism design now includes ethics by design: building fairness into the math, not patching it later.

quiz.question: Why does mechanism design raise ethical questions?
options: Designers must choose between competing values like efficiency and fairness
